title: Inject RewardMilestoneService into CompletionRepositoryImpl instead of constructing it ad hoc per call
why: Both markComplete and _markCompleteSingleInTransaction build a fresh RewardMilestoneService with `new` instead of receiving it via the constructor, unlike CompletionDetectionService which completionRepositoryProvider correctly injects. There is no seam to substitute a fake reward-milestone evaluator in a repository-level test without exercising the real Drift-backed class (Feathers), and any future dependency added to RewardMilestoneService must be threaded through by hand at both call sites.
recommendation: Accept RewardMilestoneService as an optional constructor parameter on CompletionRepositoryImpl (defaulting to a provider-supplied instance), matching the existing pattern for CompletionDetectionService/BookmarkRepository in the same class.
acceptance_criteria: RewardMilestoneService is injected via CompletionRepositoryImpl's constructor; no `RewardMilestoneService(...)` construction remains inside markComplete or _markCompleteSingleInTransaction.

corrections: RewardMilestoneService(db, profileId: X) is constructed ad hoc at ~15 sites codebase-wide (dashboard_providers.dart:320,347; reward_config_controller.dart x4; points_service.dart:139; achievements_overview_provider.dart:86; outbox_sync_write_facade.dart:141; reward_settings_merge_delegate.dart:35; child_redemption_screen.dart:53), not just the 2 cited here — this is an established (if non-compliant) codebase-wide pattern, and profileId genuinely varies per call (BulkCompletionRequest.profileId can differ from the session's active profile), so a naive single constructor-injected instance would be a correctness regression, not just a testability fix.
